parts.text: (g) In a titration, 25.0 cm 3 of 0.0800 mol / dm 3 aqueous potassium hydroxide, KOH(aq), is neutralised by 20.0 cm 3 of dilute sulfuric acid, H 2 SO 4 (aq). 2KOH(aq) + H 2 SO 4 (aq) → K 2 SO 4 (aq) + 2H 2 O(l) Calculate the concentration of H 2 SO 4 , in g / dm 3 using the following steps. ● Calculate the number of moles of KOH used. .............................. mol ● Determine the number of moles of H 2 SO 4 which react with the KOH. .............................. mol ● Calculate the concentration of H 2 SO 4 in mol / dm 3 . .............................. mol / dm 3 ● Calculate the concentration of H 2 SO 4 in g / dm 3 . .............................. g / dm 3 [5]
